STATE OF WESTBROOK, COUNTY OF MARION
APPLICATION AND AFFIDAVIT FOR SEARCH WARRANT
In re: 218 Cypress Court, Apt. 3B, Marion County

I, Detective S. Ramos, being duly sworn, depose and state:

1. I am a detective with the Marion County Police Department, assigned to the Property Crimes Unit for the past 6 years.

2. This affidavit is offered in support of an application to search the residence located at 218 Cypress Court, Apt. 3B, the listed address of DANIEL R. ORTEGA, for the following items: (a) one Apple iPhone 15, IMEI ending in -4471; (b) a black bi-fold wallet containing Westbrook driver's license issued to Alicia M. Kemp; (c) United States currency in approximately the amount of $312; (d) clothing matching the description of a dark grey hooded sweatshirt and blue jeans.

3. Probable cause is based on the following:
   a. On March 14, 2024 at 23:47, ALICIA M. KEMP reported a forcible theft of the above items at 4421 Linden Avenue.
   b. DANIEL R. ORTEGA was apprehended approximately 26 minutes later, three blocks north, in possession of a folding knife.
   c. Victim identified ORTEGA at a street show-up with reservations ("looked like him, build was right").
   d. No proceeds of the alleged theft were recovered on ORTEGA's person.

4. Affiant requests authorization to search the listed premises during daytime hours.

Sworn before me this 16th day of March, 2024.

                                /s/ Hon. P. Wexler
                                Judge, Marion County District Court

                                /s/ S. Ramos, Detective
